source:
After countless days of war the strategist was assigned to force a conclusion. A new unit was also brought in. There was excitement in the ranks. Impatience. Rikka, my mechanic, chided me as I dragged myself back from solo training.
"If you die, I can't help you," she said. "Stay alive. Hey ... is there something you want?" 
The words dug inside me. A violent force of desire suddenly surged up from some deep place. I replied: "I ... want to mate. I want to devour flesh. I want to fuck your perfect body with the force of life itself."

经过无数天的战争，军师被指派来强制终结战局。新的部队也被调来了。队伍中弥漫着兴奋与焦躁。当我拖着疲惫的身体从独自训练中回来时，我的机械师六花责备了我。“你要是死了，我也帮不了你，”她说。“活下去。嘿……你有什么想要的吗？”
这些话刺入了我的内心。一股猛烈的欲望从某个深处突然涌上来。我回答道：“我……想要交配。我想要吞噬血肉。我想要用生命本身的力量去侵犯你完美的身体。”
